definitions.explanation: The board or tray on which a painter mixes paints. Also used of a range of colours, as in English.
A flat wooden or plastic platform on which goods are stacked so that a forklift can move them. A logistics word.

examples.japanese: パレット⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧⟦{絵|え}の{具|ぐ}→絵の具：16182_enogu⟧⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{出|だ}す→出す：01087_dasu⟧。
examples.english: To squeeze paint onto a palette.
To mix colours on the palette.

notes:
English "palette" and "pallet" both become パレット in Japanese; the context makes the meaning clear.
